title: pitchiq-mcp
description: Agent-native CRM + get-booked platform. Operate over MCP, or pay per call via x402. No login.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_podcasts
toolsPreview.description: Search PitchIQ's podcast directory (ListenNotes-indexed). Returns matching shows with title, host, listener tier (small/mid/large), category, and cover image. Useful for finding podcasts an agent should pitch the user onto.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_curators
toolsPreview.description: Search PitchIQ's global Steam-curator index by name, tag, language, and audience size — for an agent marketing a game/product into a niche. Returns curator name, Steam URL, follower + review counts, and tags. x402-payable; no PAT required.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_creators
toolsPreview.description: Search PitchIQ's global Twitch/YouTube creator index by name, category, language, audience size, and whether they accept review keys — for an agent seeking creators to cover a game/product. Returns name, platform handles, followers, avg concurrent viewers, category, and top games. x402-payable; no PAT required.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_booking_book_guest_slot
toolsPreview.description: Book a confirmed guest slot on a PitchIQ host's PUBLIC booking calendar (Calendly-style). Outcome-priced — you pay per confirmed booking. Re-checks slot availability, sends the confirmation email, and pushes to the host's Google Calendar when connected. Find bookable hosts via discover_search_podcasts. x402-payable; no PAT required.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_commerce_quote_action
toolsPreview.description: Get a firm x402 price + payment requirements for any Commerce tool BEFORE committing — so an agent (or its spend policy) can budget. Returns the USD price, pricing class, network, and the x402 'accepts' block to construct the payment. x402-payable (read class).

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_brain_search
toolsPreview.description: Semantic search across the active workspace's wiki (the 'brain'). Finds pages by MEANING — it matches even when you use different words than the page does. Returns ranked pages (title, slug, summary). Prefer this over pitchiq_v1_wiki_search_pages when you don't know the exact wording. Requires an active workspace.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_brain_get_index
toolsPreview.description: Return the workspace 'brain index' — every wiki page's title, slug, and one-line summary, in hierarchy order. Call this at the START of a session to learn what the workspace already knows before searching, asking the user, or creating anything. Requires an active workspace.

toolsPreview.name: pitchiq_v1_brain_graph_query
toolsPreview.description: Traverse the workspace knowledge graph from a specific entity. For wiki_page: returns forward links, backlinks, 5 most similar pages, and CRM entity mentions found in the page text. For contact: returns linked deals, opportunities, tasks, outreach summary, conversation count, and wiki pages mentioning this contact. For deal: returns primary contact, tasks, bookings, conversation count, and wiki pages mentioning this deal. Use this to understand relationships and discover connected information across the workspace. Requires an active workspace.
